asset_role: visual-only tangent-space live-water normal; no hydraulic, collision, wet-mask, bathymetry, or raft-force authority
generation_method: project-directed generation of an orthographic Pacuare tangent-space normal with multiscale downstream and rain-fed cross-current structure
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: tileable game data texture; tangent-space RGB normal map for Unreal Engine river-water rendering. Primary request: create a square seamless tangent-space normal map for the steep tropical Pacuare River at Upper Huacas in Costa Rica. Encode irregular downstream flow ridges at mixed real-world scales from roughly 0.15 to 3 meters, narrow fast tongue streaks, broken lateral interference, rain-fed riffle microstructure, small eddy dimples, and non-repeating turbulent wavelets. Style/medium: production game data texture, not a beauty image; RGB channels encode tangent-space surface normals. Composition/framing: orthographic square, edge-to-edge, no focal point, visually seamless and suitable for mirrored addressing. Color palette: tangent-space normal blue/purple/cyan only, dominant neutral flat-normal blue around RGB 128,128,255. Constraints: uniform data-map lighting; coherent usable normals; no text, watermark, logo, banks, rocks, raft, people, water color, foam, sky, perspective, baked shadows, or baked highlights. Avoid: regular parallel bands, cellular honeycomb, obvious spirals, concentric rings, isolated icons, hard seams, and photographic lighting.
limitations: The asset is procedural visual infill rather than measured Upper Huacas surface photography.
Mirrored GPU addressing is required because opposite source-image borders are not byte-identical.
It may modulate only solver-owned wet geometry and cannot create hydraulic features.
In-engine visual, guide, water-VFX, and target-hardware acceptance remain required.
